scope: Actual official Reason Network daemons on Windows PC and SSH-connected Linux host, frozen Demian SDK adapter request/reply/inbox acknowledgment. This is transport validation, not native peer processing or model execution.

sdk.selection: Exact freshly generated deterministic SDK session address, person, machine and team scope

findingsFixed: Unhandled proxy stdin error could bypass cleanup; proxy now becomes terminal and rejects pending/later calls
Acknowledgment result alone did not prove effect; both receiving inboxes are re-read and IDs must disappear; sender status also excludes queued/rejected/expired/unknown

lifecycleChecks.limit: EPIPE event is fault injection; actual Windows OS EPIPE was not reproduced by closing the child stdin stream alone

causes: LinkInfo.team is a name, not team_id
operator.py shadowed Python stdlib operator; subsequent control uses python -I
SDK registers cli plus demian-digest session name, not agent=demian
Stale Unix socket let startup inspect old lock before recording new child; status checked the old receipt only
initialFailures.orphanRecovery: Exact private binary digest, PID, process startTicks and retained pidfd verified before stopping; separate recovery record preserved
initialFailures.correctedReadiness: New child receipt precedes readiness, matching lock PID and real SO_PEERCRED are checked; owned child terminated on failure; status detects unrecorded generation; final /proc audit excludes live private binary

remaining: Run actual inbound peer-processing through a bounded native Demian worker and link the resulting Run/receipt to source conversation/message IDs
Verify Track relation/group UI against those actual native records
Provision owner-bound Assistant executor tuple/signing/bearer/Track source mapping and verify a full Task across apps
Operating SDK/worker transition, Entra GUI and desktop/source acceptance remain
limits: Daemon transport success does not establish actual Agent/model execution, Task acceptance, or full additional-device source integration.
Separate OS hosts and a remote SSH address outside local Windows interfaces were verified; physical hardware separation was not audited.
Linux service-unit/configuration and running-container IDs were compared; this is not a new full Assistant Work/runtime DB backup or restore proof.
QA network uses isolated generated offline identities with no Reason sign-in proof. Application Entra authentication was not changed.
No contact with human teammates or existing agent sessions; only two newly registered QA SDK session addresses received synthetic messages.
Private generated team state remains offline for the next authorized stage; no global hooks, service or automatic updates were installed.
